source.notes: The Authorization header was redacted at capture time. This cassette had no X-CSRF-Token header to redact (GET request, sent with Accept: */*). GET /sap/bc/adt/packages/z_badi_check, a customer package. <pak:superPackage/> is present but EMPTY (this package has no super package) — a reader must not assume that element is always populated. Software component HOME ('Customer Developments'), transport layer ZLB1. The adtcore:responsible / adtcore:changedBy / adtcore:createdBy attributes carry a real SAP developer username (ROSENKRANZ) from the sandbox appliance; this is ordinary wire evidence, not a credential, and was left unredacted.
